context.title: Load map and context
context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, and the current map (index + touched packets). Attest c1.

packets.title: Reconcile node packets
packets.imperative: Reconcile each touched node packet against the code with evidence; update wording, status/confidence, dependencies, and rationale.

index-overlays.title: Update index and overlays
index-overlays.imperative: Update the index and overlays to match the reconciled packets.

postconditions.statement: index and overlays consistent with packets

map-compliance.title: Verify map compliance
map-compliance.imperative: Verify map compliance. Record unresolved structural questions; flag future work as triage candidates.

postconditions.statement: map compliant; open structural questions recorded

triage_candidates.statement: Dormant DB persistence boundary: #508 added processed_telemetry + session_terrain_profile_* tables (schema + _telemetry_store.py methods + protocols + unit tests) but no live src/ producer/consumer; live preprocessing->physics path still re-smooths in-memory and session_fit.py is a second FastF1 entry point. Design decision: wire physics/preprocessing through the DB persistence boundary now that it exists?
